what: The public statements this dossier decides or refuses, each with where it was read. Statements are quoted only where the source was read in full; otherwise paraphrased and marked so. Read 2026-10-26. The fields quem/disse are the Portuguese the page shows; who/said keep the reading in English for the record.

claims.who: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), the candidate who lost the second round
claims.said: É impossível reconhecer o resultado dessa eleição no contexto em que essas coisas aconteceram. Vamos pedir a anulação dessas eleições.
claims.decidable_part: whether the votes cast after the legal close (17:00 Brasília), which the extension made possible, could have decided the winner
claims.disse: É impossível reconhecer o resultado dessa eleição no contexto em que essas coisas aconteceram. Vamos pedir a anulação dessas eleições.

claims.said: Eu nunca vou saber se, num estado onde as urnas não foram reabertas, quantos votos eu poderia ter.
claims.decidable_part: none: votes that were not cast cannot be counted; a counterfactual has no bytes
claims.disse: Eu nunca vou saber se, num estado onde as urnas não foram reabertas, quantos votos eu poderia ter.

claims.said: Nossos fiscais do PL foram retirados de dentro da sala-cofre a partir do momento que essa eleição foi tomada.
claims.decidable_part: none from published data: a procedural event inside the TSE, not a number; what the totals the inspectors would have watched say is decided in C5 and C6
claims.disse: Nossos fiscais do PL foram retirados de dentro da sala-cofre a partir do momento que essa eleição foi tomada.

claims.who: The TSE (its president and its press office)
claims.said: Only about 35 thousand votes (35,521) were cast in the extended period after 17:00, an insignificant number against the final difference.
claims.source: https://www.tse.jus.br/comunicacao/noticias/2026/Outubro/presidente-do-tse-anuncia-reeleicao-de-lula-e-faz-balanco-do-2o-turno-das-eleicoes-2026 (403 to automated readers; the figure as reported by Senado Notícias, CNN Brasil and mixvale.com.br)
claims.decidable_part: the count of votes after 17:00, from the urns' own logs
claims.disse: Só cerca de 35 mil votos (35.521) foram dados no período prorrogado, depois das 17h, número insignificante diante da diferença final.

claims.said: Lula 64,256,232 votes (51.79% of valid votes), Flávio Bolsonaro 59,826,041 (48.21%), all 499,248 sections totalized.
claims.decidable_part: the signature, the arithmetic of the signed result, and its agreement with every section's boletim de urna once the TSE publishes them in bulk
claims.disse: Lula 64.256.232 votos (51,79% dos válidos), Flávio Bolsonaro 59.826.041 (48,21%), as 499.248 seções totalizadas.

claims.who: The TSE president, at the proclamation (as reported)
claims.source: reported by InfoMoney's live coverage, which noted the difference from the 51.79% of the results site
claims.decidable_part: whether 51.74% is Lula's share of the valid votes in the signed result
claims.quem: O presidente do TSE, na proclamação (segundo a imprensa)

claims.who: The final polls of the second round (Datafolha, Quaest, AtlasIntel and others)
claims.said: Flávio Bolsonaro ahead in valid votes on 24 October (e.g. 51% to 49%)
claims.source: corpus/eleicoes2026/polls.json (each poll with its own sources)
claims.decidable_part: whether each poll's published numbers, with its declared margin, contain the result; and what a miss does and does not say about the count
claims.quem: As pesquisas finais do 2º turno (Datafolha, Quaest, AtlasIntel e outras)
claims.disse: Flávio Bolsonaro à frente nos votos válidos em 24 de outubro (por exemplo, 51% a 49%).
